process.title: First the right health fund, then the right extra cover.
process.description: We do not pit insurer A against insurer B. We start with your statutory health fund, because that is where the biggest lever sits: KassenBoost shows you free of charge what contribution and bonus are possible for you. Only then do we clarify how your supplementary cover can be financed and which one fits you.
